study: Replicate tom-shlom retention and continuous QQQ hedge in feat-rs
interpretation: Replication after published outcomes were known; not preregistered confirmation
selection: Five securities, tie-aware equal weights; add 0.02 to each previous decision's positive target before selection; current eligibility overrides retention; never reset at year boundaries
forecast: Existing THINK+mixer AH+PM and restricted dynamic-hypergraph forecasts; within-seed eligible-stock percentile ranks, within-family seed averages, fixed 50:50 family blend
exposure: 20-session basket volatility targeting 20% annualized, at most 100% long; continuously short min(cap, 1-long, 0.20/max(QQQ 20-session annualized volatility,0.05))
timing: Inherited 09:20 ET decisions with AH/PM bars ending by 09:15, prior-close risk/NAV/share sizing, regular-close fills, every five sessions
costs: Inherited 0.0007 + 0.0003*sqrt(participation/0.01) per traded dollar, 1% ADV order caps, calendar-day borrow, zero cash interest/rebate, source settlement and fee-reserve rules
checks: Regenerate blend scores and retention targets from feat-rs inputs; reproduce six equal-five and six issuer source baselines; compare all 96 source schedules, daily returns, metrics, ledgers and calendar returns; independent dollar-position replay for all 96 accounts
scope: No new model training, new parameter search, 2026 scoring, trades, prospective-policy changes or replacement of existing experiment outputs
